answer: Work waits on the opal until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the signal of the next round. The ledge of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, slashed on a failed audit, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks.
